_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Revised Additional Data for Technical Publication
summary: The DID provides detailed revised or additional technical data for inclusion in existing Government specification or commercial publications affected by an approved addition, deletion, or change.
use_relationship:
To provide detailed revised or additional technical data for inclusion in existing Government specification or commercial, publication, pertaining to a specific System, equipment, or component affected by any approved addition, deletion or change.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for each technical data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
Used when structural, mechanical or electrical configuration changes occur or when any process of procedure concerning the manufacture, assembly, installation, operation, maintenance, repair and logistic support of the system, equipment or component requires additional explanation.
This DID supersedes DI-TMSS-81709.
This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81709.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference document.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including its approval date and dates of any applicable amendments and revisions, shall be as stated herein. No documents are referenced at this time. If needed, additional guidance is available at the National Security Agency, Acquisition Logistics and Deployment Review, 9800 Savage Road, Suite 6653, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6653, Attn: B81.

children.title: Government specification manuals.
children.content: Revised or additional data shall be submitted in accordance with the purchasing organizations internal technical writing standards or best business practices.

children.title: Commercial manuals.
children.content: Revised or additional data shall be submitted in the same format as the existing manual or best business practices.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Revised or additional data shall contain, as applicable, those changes, notices or replacement pages consisting of all test, tables, lists, charts, graphs, photographs, drawings, diagrams and schematics necessary to thoroughly and accurately reflect each approved addition, deletion or change to existing documents.
